Manhattan Active SCALE Documentation
        Shipping Web Service
    
    
         
                Collapse All
                Expand All
            
        View with Navigation Tools
    
    
    
    
    
        The Shipping Web Service allows access to links (URL or URI template) to other web services in the shipping functional area. For example, Shipping Container, VAS Activities and QC Assignment web services.


     Request



    
        URI: http://ServerName/ilsIntegrationServices/shipping

        Method: GET

        Accept: application/json or application/xml

        Roles: SCALEUSER,Confidential
    



     Response



    Aside from standard responses, note the following specifics for this service:

    

    
        
            
                Status Code

                Notes
            

            
                200

                
                    OK will be accompanied by an entity conforming to one of the requested media types: application/vnd.manh.ils.shipping+json, application/vnd.manh.ils.shipping+xml

                    Links available:-

                    

                    
                        
                            
                                rel

                                Media type(s)
                            

                            
                                closeContainer

                                application/vnd.manh.ils.shipping.ShippingContainersClosedRequest+json, XML 
                            

                            
                                getShipmentRate

                                application/vnd.manh.ils.shipping.rateShipmentRequest+json, XML
                            

                            
                                locateShippingContainers

                                application/vnd.manh.ils.shipping.locateShippingContainers+json, XML 
                            

                            
                                locateWaveContainers

                                none
                            

                            
                                palletBuildingForContainerList

                                application/vnd.manh.ils.shipping.ContainerReferenceList+json, XML
                            

                            
                                palletBuildingForWave

                                 none
                            

                            
                                qcAssignment

                                application/vnd.manh.ils.shipping.ContainerReferenceList+json, XML
                            

                            
                                rateShipment

                                application/vnd.manh.ils.shipping.rateShipmentRequest+json, XML
                            

                            
                                shippingContainer

                                application/vnd.manh.ils.shipping.shippingContainer+json, XML
                            

                            
                                shippingContainerVasActivities

                                application/vnd.manh.ils.shipping.shippingContainerVasActivities+json, XML 
                            

                            
                                transferShipments

                                application/vnd.manh.ils.shipping.transferShipments+json, XML 
                            

                            
                                transferShippingContainers

                                application/vnd.manh.ils.shipping.transferShippingContainers+json, XML
